_readme: Gross monthly household income ceilings for resale-flat grants, in SGD. Each figure needs a source page, the date it took effect and the date someone checked it. Set verified=true only after checking the official HDB/CPF page or the team's dated policy snapshot. Do not edit a figure without updating its source fields.

cpf_housing_grant_family.label: CPF Housing Grant (Family), resale
cpf_housing_grant_family.applies_to: Married couples / families, at least one SC applicant, first-timer
cpf_housing_grant_family.note: Was $14,000 before the August 2026 income ceiling changes. Secondary source only; confirm on HDB's 'CPF Housing Grants for Resale Flats (Families)' page.

cpf_housing_grant_single.label: CPF Housing Grant (Singles), resale
cpf_housing_grant_single.applies_to: Single SC aged 35 and above, first-timer
cpf_housing_grant_single.note: Was $7,000 before the August 2026 changes. Secondary source only.

enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_family.label: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Families)
enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_family.applies_to: First-timer families; grant amount falls as income rises
enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_family.note: No change reported in August 2026. Secondary source only.

enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_single.label: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Singles)
enhanced_cpf_housing_grant_single.applies_to: First-timer singles; for joint singles / mixed couples the rules assess half the household income

proximity_housing_grant.label: Proximity Housing Grant
proximity_housing_grant.applies_to: Buying to live with or near parents / married child
